retrieval_method: Web tool opened and inspected the linked FDA HTML and public manufacturer/distributor PDF; seed stores structured facts and short source spans, not downloaded whole-source copies.
historical_replay_caveat: Scenario date is 2025-05-02; source snapshots were inspected in October 2026. This replay is not an assertion of every source field's exact state in May 2025.

recall.reason_summary: Leaking foil-to-bottle seals on the scoped saline bottles.
recall.scope_note: Only RDI30296 is included in this fixture. The manufacturer packet also covers a separate sterile-water item, RDI30295; do not merge that item's lot list or substitute its stock.

observed_spans.locator: Product and Code Information fields; rendered lines 40-41
observed_spans.summary: RDI30296 product identifiers and all 32 affected lot identifiers recorded above.
Destruction; completed form for credit; downstream recall communication for transferred or distributed product.
Identify affected item/lot stock, quarantine it, then follow the destruction instruction.

observed_spans.quote: Even if you do not have any affected product
observed_spans.summary: Manufacturer requests the completed destruction form, including a response when no affected product is present; credit is conditional on receipt.
Notify recipients when product has been transferred to another person, department or location, and include downstream quantities in the response.
Affected lots; includes 23JJA103, matching FDA, rather than the inconsistent distributor-cover identifier.

known_source_conflicts.handling: Record conflict; use the exact lot in the scoped FDA record and manufacturer attachment for this fixture. Never silently rewrite a stock lot or classify 23IJA103 as an exact match. Requires human review if that ambiguous identifier occurs.

required_tasks.execution_semantics: A digital allocation hold does not prove physical quarantine.
RecallOps prepares a task; no actual destruction is claimed or performed.
Draft quantities and form checklist only. No submission or credit receipt is claimed.
Conditional on actual onward distribution. The seed contains no onward-distribution history; do not invent notified recipients or send messages.

source_precedence_note: Do not universally rank FDA above a manufacturer's later update. Compare scope, issue date and revisions. This fixture uses the matching FDA/manufacturer lot scope and retains the cover-letter discrepancy.
nonclaims: The fixture does not establish real inventory, patient exposure, product substitutability, physical quarantine, destruction, communication, submitted response or credit.
Nonmatching lots are not listed in this recall; general safety cannot be inferred.
